The '''Tribal Wargear''' [[workshop]] is a way to make primitive [[Armor]] out of [[cv:Leather|Lamellar Leather]] and tribal [[Weapon]]s out of [[cv:Stone|Rock]], [[cv:Ash|Ash]], [[cv:Bone|Bone]], [[cv:Blood|Blood]], [[cv:Obsidian|Obsidian]] and [[cv:Adamantine|Adamantine]].

==Menu==
'''Tribal Wargear'''
*{{K|t}} Harden [[cv:Leather|Leather]] with [[cv:Tallow|Tallow]]
*{{K|w}} Laminate [[cv:Leather|Leather]] with [[Wood]]
*{{K|s}} Laminate [[cv:Leather|Leather]] with [[cv:Shell|Shell]]
*{{K|h}} Laminate [[cv:Leather|Leather]] with [[cv:Horn|Horn]]
*{{K|a}} Craft [[cv:Leather|Lamellar]] [[cv:Armor|Wargear]] Set
*{{K|m}} Craft [[cv:Leather|Lamellar]] [[cv:Armor|Mask]]
*{{K|c}} Craft [[cv:Leather|Lamellar]] [[cv:Armor|Cloak]]
*{{K|r}} Craft [[cv:Leather|Lamellar]] [[cv:Armor|Robe]]
*{{K|C}} Handcrafted Tribal [[Metal|Ironbone]] [[cv:Weapon|Claws]]
*{{K|ctrl+c}} Handcrafted Tribal [[Metal|Bloodsteel]] [[cv:Weapon|Claws]]
* Handcrafted Tribal [[cv:Obsidian|Obsidian]] [[cv:Weapon|Claws]]
* Handcrafted Tribal [[cv:Adamantine|Adamantine]] [[cv:Weapon|Claws]]
*{{K|M}} Handcrafted Tribal [[Metal|Ironbone]] [[cv:Weapon|Macahuitl]]
*{{K|ctrl+m}} Handcrafted Tribal [[Metal|Bloodsteel]] [[cv:Weapon|Macahuitl]]
* Handcrafted Tribal [[cv:Obsidian|Obsidian]] [[cv:Weapon|Macahuitl]]
* Handcrafted Tribal [[cv:Adamantine|Adamantine]] [[cv:Weapon|Macahuitl]]
*{{K|S}} Handcrafted Tribal [[Metal|Ironbone]] [[cv:Spear|Warspear]]
*{{K|ctrl+s}} Handcrafted Tribal [[Metal|Bloodsteel]] [[cv:Spear|Spear]]
* Handcrafted Tribal [[cv:Obsidian|Obsidian]] [[cv:Spear|Spear]]
* Handcrafted Tribal Bola Thrower
* Handcrafted Tribal Bolas
* Make a [[cv:Stone|Rock]] [[cv:Weapon|Maul]]
* Make a [[cv:Stone|Rock]] [[cv:Weapon|Club]]

==Common Uses==
Early game [[Armor]] and [[Weapon]] making.
